# Pixel Tip Calculator

A retro pixel-art themed tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works fully offline.

## Features

- Enter bill amount and number of people
- Choose tip percentage: 10%, 15%, or 20%
- Displays tip per person and total per person
- Keyboard-accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive layout from 360px wide
- Pixel-art aesthetic with a cohesive dark palette

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `styles.css` — pixel theme, layout, and interactive states
- `script.js` — calculation logic and event handling

## Accessibility

- All inputs have associated labels
- Tip buttons use `aria-pressed` to indicate selection
- Results update in an `aria-live` region
- Focus indicators are clearly visible
